## Overview

Capture the Qwen GDN core in the breakable CUDA graphs of mixed (prefill + decode) steps, instead of running it as an eager break in every GDN layer. This is the second of two PRs and is stacked on #61779 (persistent padded mixed-batch metadata and static-grid GDN prefill kernels); only the last 4 commits are new here. It also works with prefix caching (Mamba `align` mode).

On an 8 × A100 hybrid model deployment it cuts the mixed-step host time from 99 to 55 ms and gives TPOT P50 −9 to −10 % and requests/s +4 to +7 % at 32 concurrent agentic sessions. Related: SGLang issue [#35851](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/35851) (same per-layer break cost).

## Claims

- Inside a breakable PIECEWISE capture, the GDN core ops (`qwen_gdn_attention_core`, `qwen_gdn_attention_core_fused_norm_packed`) are captured into the current graph segment when the static form applies; otherwise they break as before.
- The captured core (`_forward_core_static`) is branch-free. It reads only persistent capture buffers at full length and sizes every grid by the graph's token count and `max_num_seqs`, so one graph replays correctly for any batch padded to that count: spec decodes, non-spec decodes, prefills, any mix, zero-length rows. Pad rows write only the null state block and a scratch output row.
- With prefix caching, `mamba_cache_mode="align"` is supported when the Mamba spec has no internal prefill checkpoint blocks (`num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks == 0`); otherwise the core breaks as before.
- No change: the eager forward, FULL decode graphs, FlashInfer / CuteDSL / AITER FlyDSL / XPU / ROCm paths, the V1 runner. No new host sync.

## Validation

### Serving (this PR + #61779)

**Setup.** Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 (36 GDN + 12 sparse-attention layers, MTP 3), TP8 + EP, DCP 4, 8 × A100-SXM4-40GB, prefix caching (`align`, `--prefix-match-unit 16`), `--max-num-batched-tokens 2048`, MLPerf agentic multi-turn workload, 32 concurrent sessions, 1 × 60 min per arm. Two pairs on two nodes; the second pair runs the arms in reversed order. Both PRs are backported onto 5555a2d8f to match the available image. TTFT and TPOT come from a full replay of every request with the benchmark client's own TPOT code.

| Pair | Arm | TTFT P50 / P95 / P99 | TPOT P50 / P95 / P99 | Requests/s |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | without | 978 / 1,816 / 2,730 ms | 17.6 / 26.4 / 31.9 ms | 2.86 |
| 1 | with | 926 / 2,335 / 7,811 ms* | 16.0 / 26.1 / 38.8 ms | 2.98 |
| 2 | with | 943 / 1,972 / 3,659 ms | 15.7 / 24.5 / 32.7 ms | 3.09 |
| 2 | without | 954 / 1,743 / 2,571 ms | 17.6 / 26.3 / 31.0 ms | 2.89 |

\* includes a 160 s window in which requests did not reach the engine (the engine was idle; cause not found).

- Both pairs: TPOT P50 −9 to −10 %, requests/s +4 to +7 %.
- TTFT P95 is higher with the PR in both pairs (+13 % in pair 2). A third run of the "with" arm on another day gave TTFT P95 1,829 ms, so the tail moves by about as much between runs as between arms. I do not claim a TTFT change in either direction.

### Mixed-step anatomy (nsys, same deployment, C32, all 8 ranks, p50 per mixed step)

| | without | with |
|---|---|---|
| Host issue time | 99.3 ms | **55.4 ms** |
| GDN eager-break host time | 55.2 ms (720 launches) | 0 |
| Time the GPUs wait in collectives for other ranks | 9.3 ms | 0.7 ms |

Small mixed steps (< 256 prefill tokens) fall from 99.5 to 40.3 ms of GPU span. After this PR the mixed step is GPU-bound: the host runs about 80 ms ahead of the GPU.

### Tests

- GPU (4 × A100-SXM4-40GB, same commits backported onto 5555a2d8f, every changed file checked against the image copy before the PR files are laid over):

  | File | Result |
  |---|---|
  | `tests/kernels/mamba/test_gdn_static_core_capture.py` (new) | 9 passed |
  | `tests/kernels/mamba/test_gdn_static_grid.py` (#61779) | 15 passed |
  | `tests/kernels/mamba/test_causal_conv1d.py` | 164 passed |
  | `tests/v1/cudagraph/test_breakable_cudagraph.py` | 22 passed |
  | `tests/v1/attention/test_gdn_metadata_builder.py` | 75 passed |

  The new test captures one graph of 64 tokens and replays it for 11 batch kinds (plain and fused-norm core, bf16 and fp32 SSM state). Core output and every non-null conv / SSM state block are bitwise equal to the eager `_forward_core` (decode-only batch: `assert_close`, see Limitations).
- Engine start (same GPU job): a small Qwen4Exp configuration, TP4 + DCP, MTP 3, MRV2, prefix caching in `align` mode: 128 tokens generated; a probe counted 264 captured GDN core calls and 0 eager breaks.
- CPU (macOS, CPU platform): the new and changed files pass; the 4 failures in `test_breakable_cudagraph.py` fail the same way without this PR (they need a device graph pool).
- Lint: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` clean.
- Sync: the diff adds no host reads of device tensors. Not yet run under `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`.

```bash
python -m pytest tests/kernels/mamba/test_gdn_static_core_capture.py tests/kernels/mamba/test_gdn_static_grid.py \
  tests/v1/cudagraph/test_breakable_cudagraph.py tests/v1/attention/test_gdn_metadata_builder.py
```

## Details

**Motivation.** In mixed steps the GDN core runs as an eager break between graph segments because its metadata and grids change every step. On the deployment above that is 36 breaks per step, 55.2 ms of host time and 720 of 1,348 launches. Removing Python-level indexing alone (#61034) did not change the step (99.3 vs 99.6 ms), so the launches themselves must go into the graph.

**Design.**
- `eager_break_during_capture(capturable=...)`: a per-call predicate; an accepted call runs inline and is captured. `BreakableCUDAGraphCapture.run_uncaptured(fn)` runs a warm-up between two segments without recording it, so Triton compiles and autotunes outside the capture.
- Builder: `captures_mixed_batches` (breakable PIECEWISE graphs, MRV2, CUDA, Triton/FLA backend, base builder, no internal prefill checkpoint blocks). Then every batch is staged into the persistent buffers of #61779 at full length (`GDNAttentionMetadata.capture_buffers`), because the graph of a token count replays for every batch padded to it. Two capture-only cu_seqlens describe the non-spec rows as one token stream with the peeled decodes first.
- Layer: one static path. The spec part runs on `max_num_seqs` padded rows like FULL decode; the non-spec conv uses `num_programs`; the decode peel uses zero-length pads; the FLA chunk uses `use_graph=True` and absolute cu_seqlens; the output merge is a fixed-length `index_copy_` into a scratch row.
- `build_for_cudagraph_capture` keeps its decode-only check: PIECEWISE capture metadata comes from `build()`, and no static grid depends on the capture batch. FULL mixed graphs (`AttentionCGSupport.ALWAYS`) are out of scope.

**Trade-offs.**
- GPU work per mixed step rises about 10–15 % at the same prefill size: the GDN core now runs at the graph's padded token count. The host saving is larger, so the step is still faster.
- Capture memory: the gathered SSM states of `max_num_seqs` rows plus FLA workspaces of `cdiv(T, 64) + max_num_seqs - 1` chunks, in the graph pool. Measured on the deployment: 1.73 GiB of graph memory per GPU against 1.41 GiB without.

**Limitations.**
- A batch with only non-spec decodes that replays a PIECEWISE graph runs `causal_conv1d_fn` instead of `causal_conv1d_update`; a spec-only batch on the fused-norm op runs the Triton spec kernels instead of the fused CUDA MTP kernel. Both are correct, but not bitwise identical to eager.
- Every step stages about 12 more small device copies when the static form is enabled (also decode-only steps).
- Internal Mamba prefill checkpoints (#60050, #60659) and capture are exclusive for now: with checkpoint blocks the core breaks as before. A static checkpoint export inside the captured segment is possible but out of scope. #60659 also writes split metadata into the chunk-index buffers that #61779 makes persistent; whichever lands second must keep the split metadata separate.

**Size:** +470 / −9 outside tests (`qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py` +275, `gdn_attn.py` +164, `breakable_cudagraph.py` +40); tests +605.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Breakable CUDA graph capture of the static GDN core.
+
+The breakable CUDA graph of a token count captures the GDN core when the
+metadata builder stages its capture buffers, and replays it for every batch
+padded to that count. One graph, captured once, must equal the eager
+``_forward_core`` bitwise for batches of every kind: the core output and every
+conv and SSM state block except the null block, which pad rows may write.
+With prefix caching (Mamba "align" mode) the state indices select each row's
+current block, and a prefill chunk ends at a block boundary, so its final state
+is the block's checkpoint.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import types
+from dataclasses import replace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.v1.attention.utils import (
+    BatchSpec,
+    create_common_attn_metadata,
+    create_vllm_config,
+)
+from vllm.compilation.breakable_cudagraph import BreakableCUDAGraphCapture
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode, SpeculativeConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.gdn import qwen_gdn_linear_attn
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.gdn.qwen_gdn_linear_attn import (
+    ChunkGatedDeltaRule,
+    QwenGatedDeltaNetAttention,
+    _qwen_gdn_attention_core_fused_norm_packed_is_capturable,
+    _qwen_gdn_attention_core_is_capturable,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.mamba_utils import MambaStateShapeCalculator
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.gdn_attn import (
+    GDNAttentionMetadata,
+    GDNAttentionMetadataBuilder,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import MambaSpec
+
+H = 4  # key heads
+HV = 8  # value heads
+K = 128  # head_k_dim
+V = 128  # head_v_dim
+CONV_KERNEL = 4
+CONV_DIM = 2 * H * K + HV * V
+NUM_SPEC = 2
+BLOCK_SIZE = 16
+PREFIX = "model.layers.0.linear_attn"
+# Capacity of the builder's buffers, and the token count of the graph.
+MAX_NUM_SEQS = 16
+MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS = 128
+NUM_CAPTURED_TOKENS = 64
+NUM_STATE_BLOCKS = 256
+
+# (seq_lens, query_lens, num_decode_draft_tokens, is_prefilling), decode rows
+# first as the scheduler orders them; None leaves a field unset.
+BATCHES = {
+    "spec_only": ([20, 30, 9], [3, 3, 3], [2, 2, 2], None),
+    "prefill_only": ([40, 57], [40, 17], [-1, -1], None),
+    "spec_and_prefill": ([20, 65, 100], [3, 1, 50], [2, -1, -1], None),
+    "decode_and_prefill": ([40, 41, 200], [1, 1, 60], None, None),
+    "one_token_prefills": ([40, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1], None, [False, True, True]),
+    "spec_and_one_token_prefills": ([30, 1, 1], [3, 1, 1], [2, -1, -1], None),
+    "max_sequences": (
+        [30] * 6 + [10] * 10,
+        [3] * 6 + [2] * 10,
+        [2] * 6 + [-1] * 10,
+        None,
+    ),
+    "all_tokens": ([30, 90], [3, 61], [2, -1], None),
+    "zero_length_rows": ([40, 100, 16, 16], [1, 50, 0, 0], None, None),
+    "spec_and_zero_length_rows": ([65, 20, 16], [1, 3, 0], [-1, 2, -1], None),
+    # Prefix caching ("align"): a chunk from a cached prefix to a block
+    # boundary, a chunk that starts after a cached prefix, and spec decodes
+    # whose tokens cross a block boundary next to a prefill.
+    "prefill_to_block_boundary": ([64, 48], [32, 16], [-1, -1], None),
+    "prefill_after_cached_prefix": ([80], [32], [-1], None),
+    "spec_across_block_boundary_and_prefill": (
+        [33, 34, 64],
+        [3, 3, 16],
+        [2, 2, -1],
+        None,
+    ),
+    # Eager runs causal_conv1d_update on a batch of only non-spec decodes,
+    # the captured core causal_conv1d_fn, so only this one may differ.
+    "decode_only": ([40, 30, 20], [1, 1, 1], None, None),
+}
+NOT_BITWISE_BATCHES = {"decode_only"}
+# Tolerance of NOT_BITWISE_BATCHES: the conv rounding reaches the state.
+NOT_BITWISE_TOLERANCE = 6e-2
+
+
+def _make_builder(
+    device: torch.device, mamba_cache_mode: str
+) -> GDNAttentionMetadataBuilder:
+    vllm_config = create_vllm_config(
+        model_name="Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B",
+        block_size=BLOCK_SIZE,
+        max_num_seqs=MAX_NUM_SEQS,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS,
+        hf_config_override={"linear_key_head_dim": K},
+    )
+    vllm_config.additional_config = {"gdn_prefill_backend": "triton"}
+    vllm_config.speculative_config = SpeculativeConfig(
+        method="ngram", num_speculative_tokens=NUM_SPEC
+    )
+    vllm_config.cache_config.mamba_cache_mode = mamba_cache_mode
+    builder = GDNAttentionMetadataBuilder(
+        kv_cache_spec=MambaSpec(
+            block_size=BLOCK_SIZE,
+            shapes=((16, 64),),
+            dtypes=(torch.float16,),
+            num_speculative_blocks=NUM_SPEC,
+        ),
+        layer_names=[PREFIX],
+        vllm_config=vllm_config,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    # Breakable PIECEWISE graphs on MRV2 enable it; the test needs only the
+    # buffers.
+    builder.captures_mixed_batches = True
+    return builder
+
+
+def _build(
+    builder: GDNAttentionMetadataBuilder, name: str, device: torch.device
+) -> GDNAttentionMetadata:
+    seq_lens, query_lens, draft_tokens, is_prefilling = BATCHES[name]
+    batch = BatchSpec(seq_lens=seq_lens, query_lens=query_lens)
+    # A distinct state block per entry; block 0 is the null block. "align"
+    # mode takes the 1 + NUM_SPEC blocks from each row's current block on.
+    num_block_cols = NUM_SPEC + 1
+    if builder.vllm_config.cache_config.mamba_cache_mode == "align":
+        num_block_cols += cdiv(max(seq_lens), BLOCK_SIZE) - 1
+    block_table = 1 + torch.randperm(NUM_STATE_BLOCKS - 1, device=device)[
+        : batch.batch_size * num_block_cols
